ADR 0040: embedded windows expand their width using the actual title font and close-button allowance, bounded by MaxSize. Independent native title metrics are unavailable; enabled native roots fail explicitly before acquiring resources.
ADRs 0031/0038: permanent independently rebindable dialog-close action; Escape default and Command-W on macOS use the actual typed InputMap loader and domain validation.
ADRs 0031/0038/0040: validated typed Auto/Cancel First/OK First project definition drives newly added dialog cancel buttons, with platform order available before native startup.

ADRs 0040/0095: active retained display service returns the executable platform dialog order (Windows OK-first, other accepted profiles Cancel-first); owner-thread and unavailable-service guards execute. Dialog authoring uses the same internal platform policy before startup; foreign-platform acceptance remains ADR 0021 scoped.
